meta.title: Optimize interpreter performance
meta.body_summary: Optimize Mochi interpreter performance by caching builtin function table, pooling environment objects, using AcquireEnv/ReleaseEnv, and lowering inline call threshold.

core_change_summary.description: In interpreter/builtins.go, added caching of builtin function table. In interpreter/interpreter.go, added environment pooling helpers (AcquireEnv/ReleaseEnv) and applied them in loops, if-statements, and function calls; also lowered the inline call threshold. In types/env.go, added pooling support with 120 new lines.
